rationale: C25 is an almost verbatim two-sentence drafting template for the child, with only the organization name changed. It shares both the operative designation sentence and the distinctive non-abridgment sentence, including the formulation “shall not be deemed to abridge.” C15 is similarly close but uses “such organization,” while C09 follows the same structure with the less exact phrase “is not intended to abridge.”

shared_material.child_excerpt: I hereby designate the Coffee Study Group as a public international organization entitled to enjoy the privileges, exemptions, and immunities conferred by the International Organizations Immunities Act.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: I hereby designate the Inter-American Development Bank as a public international organization entitled to enjoy the privileges, exemptions, and immunities conferred by the International Organizations Immunities Act.
shared_material.explanation: The complete operative designation sentence is reused with the organization name substituted.

shared_material.child_excerpt: The designation of the Coffee Study Group as a public international organization within the meaning of the International Organizations Immunities Act shall not be deemed to abridge in any respect privileges, exemptions, and immunities which that organization may have acquired or may acquire by treaty or congressional action.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The designation of the Inter-American Development Bank as a public international organization within the meaning of the International Organizations Immunities Act shall not be deemed to abridge in any respect privileges, exemptions, and Immunities which that organization may have acquired or may acquire by treaty or congressional action.
shared_material.explanation: The child reproduces C25’s distinctive second sentence essentially word for word, again changing only the named organization and immaterial capitalization.
